rows.contract: Native resources can fail creation and need actionable diagnostics.
rows.native_mapping: Use a typed helper that checks nil and turns NSError information into a native Metal error.
rows.expected_result: Header fixture verifies a real native queue protocol return type. Runtime checks retained success and error fields.
rows.actual_result: Real ARC header, compilation, link and available CPU diagnostics passed.

rows.contract: The device registry ID identifies a Metal device across tasks.
rows.native_mapping: Store registry ID for diagnostics and use an independent shared context identity for authorization of work. Two contexts sharing one device remain distinct.
rows.expected_result: Prepare two contexts from one Metal device and reject the first context work lease in the second.
rows.actual_result: Real Metal device or dependent scheduler is unavailable; CPU diagnostics passed.

rows.contract: Resources and queued work must be bound to the correct active device generation.
rows.native_mapping: A work lease retains context state; a move-only submission guard protects the generation across submission.
rows.expected_result: Check empty, stale, foreign, valid and closed lease statuses and serialize close against an active submission guard.
rows.actual_result: Real Metal device or dependent scheduler is unavailable; CPU diagnostics passed.
